name: 70002 · Metairie, LA
findings: ZIP 70002 (Metairie) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70002 (Metairie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70002 (Metairie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
